release_notes:
YOuTUbE 1.0.0 — Initial Release
• Windows Desktop installer (64-bit)
• Android signed APK (Kotlin & Jetpack Compose)
• High quality video (up to 8K) and audio downloading
• Queue support for downloading multiple videos sequentially
• Local download history with search and offline replay
• Automatic background tool updates (yt-dlp, ffmpeg, deno)
• Native YouTube dark and light themes
